verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public REST API covering the core workflows. It has per-endpoint reference docs for customer monitoring, exports, case audit trails, roles and transaction processing. Credentials are self-serve under API Credentials with permissions and expiry, and the docs cover sync, async and batch screening, rate-limit headers, versioning and a Postman collection. A probe retrieved and parsed the OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema at /openapi/mesh-api.json; the 404s on other candidate paths do not contradict this. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of authenticated API operations, since the probe retrieved documentation only.
